$comment: Package manifest for bootstrap.ps1. Edit here, not in the script.
probe  - a command name or file path. If it resolves, the package counts as
installed no matter how it got there (winget, scoop, MSI, corp image).
altIds - other winget IDs that satisfy the same need; if any is present, skip.
extraArgs - extra winget arguments, e.g. pinning --source msstore.
font   - match an installed font family instead of asking winget.

fonts.note: Required: Windows Terminal + starship + eza glyphs

shell.note: prompt; its installer does not add itself to PATH

dev.note: Microsoft.Git is the VFS-for-Git fork on corp monorepo machines. Never install Git.Git over it.
no probe: bare 'python' may be the Store app-execution-alias stub
no probe: 'dotnet' may come from a different SDK band

apps.note: Snipping Tool (Win+Shift+S). msstore package, so pin the source. Probe by the app execution alias: it is an Appx, and 'winget list' does not report it as installed.

psModules.name: PSFzf
psModules.note: lazy-loaded by the profile on first Ctrl+t/Ctrl+r
